wiki.title: Bob's Burgers
wiki.body:
The Belcher family's burger restaurant on Ocean Avenue, with the family's apartment upstairs. Run by **Bob and Linda Belcher** with 'help' from Tina, Gene, and Louise.

## The Burger of the Day
The chalkboard pun burger changes constantly and is almost always better than business is. Bob takes it more seriously than nearly anything else.

## Notes
- Squeezed between It's Your Funeral Home and, at various times, an ever-failing storefront next door
- Directly across the street from Jimmy Pesto's Pizzeria, to Bob's eternal irritation
- The grand re-re-re-opening happened in the very first episode
